name: io.github.0xmortuex/syzbot-mcp
description: Fetch and explain syzbot Linux kernel bug reports: KASAN, KCSAN, lockdep, WARNING, hung tasks.

environmentVariables.name: SYZBOT_MCP_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory (default: the user cache dir)

environmentVariables.name: SYZBOT_MCP_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between requests to syzbot (default 1.5, minimum 1)
